name: Berried in bliss overnight oats
ingredients_raw: Oat Products (46%), Jaggery Powder (17%), Seeds (8.6%) [Pumpkin Seeds, Flax Seeds, Chia Seeds], Nuts & Raisins (2.5%) [Raisins, Almond], Strawberry Powder (1.7%), Refined Rice Bran Oil, Flavour (Natural Flavouring Substances), Iodised Salt. Crunchy Topping:: Cereal Products (15%) [Wheat Flakes, Jowar Flakes, Rolled Oats, Corn Flakes], Jaggery Powder (3%), Flax Seeds, Beetroot Powder, Flavour (Natural Flavouring Substances).
